title: GitHub Actions example

- name: Deploy infrastructure
  env:
    ATMOS_ENVIRONMENT: production
    CI_COMMIT_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
  run: |
    atmos terraform apply vpc -s prod/us-east-1
